versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Faceless units that copy other cards' text and tribe (Guise), grow the longer a copy lasts, and cash in when found out.
They also carve blank stat copies (Stocks), swap units with the shop, and turn copies into triples.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Closed the Seamstress loop (each unit uses a copied When played once a turn) and ruled that a Stock of the Lady is a second Lady that ignores her.
Also made Grandfer's Unmask optional, gave Foundling a minimum payout, and said how golden Guises count for triples.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled where a carved Stock lands and that the Lady's copied When played texts don't fire; a unit wearing her Guise is now openly another Lady.
Keeper of the Lost Hour can move Worn between Guises, and Guise cards read "wear the Guise of" so they read at a glance.
